description: Everything the Geode window is allowed to call. Tauri v2 denies plugin commands unless a capability grants them; the app's own #[tauri::command] handlers do not need listing here. `opener:allow-open-url` needs more than the bare permission: the plugin asks `self.allowed.iter().any(...)`, which is false for an empty list, so granting the command without a scope opens nothing at all and says so nowhere a person can see. The glob is matched against the whole URL with separators unescaped, so `https://*` covers a path and a fragment and still refuses `file://`, `javascript:` and cleartext `http://` — which is the point of naming a scheme rather than `*`.
